newsitem.title: USA: KTI Inc says refinances $13.4 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: KTI Inc says refinances $13.4 mln in debt.

text.p: KTI Inc said Thursday it had refinanced $13.4 million of tax-exempt debt issued on behalf of a recently acquired subsidiary, Timber Energy Resources Inc.

The transaction resulted in replacing variable rate bonds with 7 percent fixed coupon rates with average maturity of four years and eliminating the credit enhancement provided by the Bank of Montreal.
KTI acquired Timber Energy Resources, Inc. on November 22, 1996 from CNA Financial, the principal seller, and other minority stockholders for $2 million in cash and $13.4 million in tax exempt debt.
